key_impacts: More than one million people were displaced.
At least five million people were affected across Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, India, Thailand, Seychelles, and Myanmar.
Many hospitals and health centres were destroyed or damaged.
Water supplies were disrupted and contaminated; sanitation facilities were damaged.
evidence_snippets: On 26 December 2004, a 9.0 earthquake west of northern Sumatra triggered a powerful tsunami.
At least five million people were affected in Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, India, Thailand, Seychelles, Myanmar.
Death toll exceeded 280,000; over one million displaced; hospitals and water and sanitation systems were damaged.
